_comment: Dish photographs extracted from the restaurant's own menu PDF, mapped to
dishes by the caption printed beside each photo (e.g. 'n° 43 - Hue Spicy
Beef Soup'), then checked by eye. Keys are printed dish numbers.
Two are deliberately narrower than their caption. The n° 12 photo shows
prawn rolls, so it is assigned to 12.2 Prawn only rather than to all four
summer-roll variants — a beef roll illustrated by a prawn one is worse
than no picture. The n° 91 photo is captioned 'Red Curry with Beef' and
goes to 91.3 alone for the same reason.
Dishes absent from this file have no photograph and render none. The menu
PDF simply does not contain one for them; nothing has been substituted.
